description: git-maintenance push-delete. cc-safety-net denies `git push --delete` (rule `git.push-delete`), and nobody can allowlist its built-in git rules. The repository routes other blocked git maintenance through `.agro/scripts/git-maintenance.sh`. The operator chose a shim verb over disabling cc-safety-net.

userStories.title: Delete a remote branch through the git maintenance shim
userStories.description: As the operator, I want agents to delete a merged remote branch through `git-maintenance.sh`. cc-safety-net then keeps its guard on every other destructive git command.
acceptanceCriteria: `bash .agro/scripts/git-maintenance.sh push-delete <remote> <branch>` runs `git push <remote> --delete <branch>` and prints `git-maintenance.sh: ran: git push <remote> --delete <branch>`.
For `<branch>` equal to `development`, `main`, or `master`, the verb exits 2, prints a refusal to stderr, and runs no push.
With a wrong argument count, the verb prints the usage and exits 2.
The usage text, the `/git` maintenance block in `.agro/skills/git/SKILL.md`, and section 3 of `docs/security-considerations.md` name `push-delete`.
`.agro/scripts/__tests__/git-maintenance.test.ts` covers a delete against a local bare remote, each refused branch, and the usage error.
